measuredAgainst: texas/tx-law-of-agency-30-v1/reviewer-surface — the RENDERED course, driven in Chromium
tool: axe-core (wcag2a, wcag2aa, wcag21a, wcag21aa) plus scripted keyboard, focus, live-region, viewport and zoom checks
limits: Automated and scripted checks only. No test here substitutes for testing with real assistive technology and real users, and a pass may not be described as one.

findings.detail: axe accessible-name and ARIA-relationship rules across 19 pages
axe heading-order, empty-heading and page-has-heading-one
axe label rules — every input, textarea and radio has a programmatic label
each question is a fieldset with a legend; choices are a labelled radiogroup
axe color-contrast at WCAG AA
feedback is delivered through role=status with aria-live=polite rather than colour alone
33 focusable controls on a topic page, every one reachable and focusable
skip link "Skip to main content" becomes visible on focus; a 3px outline is defined for :focus-visible on links, buttons, inputs and textareas
an incorrect answer announced "Not correct. Read the explanation below; a different related question follows." through role=status/aria-live=polite and revealed a 631-character rationale
progress conveyed in text through a status region: "Topic 1 of 12 · 130 prescribed minutes"
19 scenario controls, every one labelled; no length requirement stated on the page
3 question groups each in a fieldset with a legend, navigation landmark present, placeholder notice shown
1366x768 — no horizontal overflow
768x1024 — no horizontal overflow
375x667 — no horizontal overflow
content reflows at 200% zoom without horizontal scrolling
NOT APPLICABLE — this course includes no video or audio, so no caption or transcript is owed. Any future media must ship captions and a transcript before this criterion can pass.
every button, link and input across 19 pages is driven by a handler or has a destination; no decorative badge, icon or seal element is rendered
2 optional region(s) on topic-T02.html, each stating "not required"; Next has a destination; nothing inside an optional region is required or disabled; 0 media elements, so no video gates anything
the explanation was revealed by selecting a choice and pressing one button with nothing typed; 0 inputs carry a minlength attribute; no page states a word or character minimum
against deliberately broken markup: everyControlHasAFunction found 3 offenders, optionalMaterialNeverBlocks returned false, noMinimumTypedLength returned false — each the opposite of a pass
